title: Replace terminal timeout process-tree test’s sleep-and-marker race with owned readiness
outcome: Replace terminal timeout process-tree test’s sleep-and-marker race with owned readiness
acceptance: run_terminal_shell_command_timeout_kills_process_tree proves descendant readiness and exact process ownership before observing timeout cleanup, with a phase-controlled lifetime rather than relying on 500 ms startup and a 1.5 s delayed marker.
Keep the timeout result and descendant-termination property without retry, increased production timeouts or a marker window that can falsely pass before a delayed child writes.
